description: NaBaPrWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.19 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Pr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.92 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Pr, and one W atom.
